teableio-agent-skills-teable-app-builder.description: Build, change, run and publish a Teable app (an App Builder app, Next.js on Teable data) from this machine with the `teable` CLI instead of the in-app chat. Use when the user wants to create a Teable app, work on an existing one locally, push a new version, publish it, roll back, or react to table-schema changes and named-query repairs. Covers project (base) resolution, `teable app init|clone|pull|push|publish`, the local dev loop and the platform rules the checkout must follow.

teableio-agent-skills-teable-assistant-o.description: Operate Teable projects — tables, fields, views, records, SQL queries, automations, headless routines, apps, image generation, and web scraping — through the `teable` CLI. Requires an environment that can run shell commands. Trigger when user mentions Cuppy, Teable, teable CLI, or Teable-style IDs (bseXXX, tblXXX, fldXXX, recXXX, viwXXX), or wants to manage tables/fields/records, build dashboards/apps, generate images or charts, create automations, import/export data, trigger AI fill, or scrape websites (LinkedIn, Amazon, YouTube, etc.) — even if they don't explicitly say "Teable" but are…
